cases.title: L1, L2, and L3 preserve routes while compacting parent evidence units
cases.requirement: L1 keeps message evidence; each higher level uses direct child IDs, routes every child, and carries the deterministic promotion manifest.
cases.expected: L3 validates with two direct child routes and no promoted-state growth beyond its children

cases.title: Missing promoted durable state fails closed
cases.requirement: A parent cannot pass after removing an accepted decision, task, open question, uncertainty, withdrawal, or correction selected by the deterministic manifest.
cases.expected: validator rejects the candidate before persistence

cases.title: Parent delegates ordinary detail and exact locators without losing navigation
cases.requirement: Ordinary explicit facts and exact anchors stay in L1, while L2 routes to their child and cannot omit that child.
cases.expected: ordinary fact is absent from promotion manifest, child remains represented, and parent anchors stay empty

cases.title: Candidate identity binds the hierarchy implementation set
cases.requirement: The candidate SHA-256 is computed from the ordered path and SHA-256 list for the ten declared implementation and evidence files.
cases.runner: SHA-256 over canonical ordered path and file-hash manifest

historical_failures.description: The prior parent source treated every child item as a required evidence unit and forced ordinary child detail to be repeated upward.
Message-level source coverage alone did not prove that an open question or other durable state survived semantic compression.
